description: This file defines the API and data structures for managing submodule configurations in a Git repository, including functions for lookup, parsing, and cache management related to submodules.

classes.name: submodule
classes.description: Structure representing a Git submodule with its configuration details.

classes.name: submodule_tree_entry
classes.description: Structure representing a submodule entry within a tree, including repository and configuration info.

classes.name: submodule_entry_list
classes.description: Structure managing a list of submodule tree entries.

methods.name: submodule_from_path
methods.description: Retrieves a submodule by its path in a given repository and commit/tree.

methods.name: submodule_from_name
methods.description: Retrieves a submodule by its name in a given repository and commit/tree.

methods.name: submodule_free
methods.description: Frees cached submodule data associated with a repository.

methods.name: print_config_from_gitmodules
methods.description: Prints configuration from the .gitmodules file for a repository.

methods.name: config_set_in_gitmodules_file_gently
methods.description: Sets configuration key-value pairs in the .gitmodules file gently.

methods.name: check_submodule_name
methods.description: Validates the syntax of a submodule name.

methods.name: check_submodule_url
methods.description: Validates the URL of a submodule.

methods.name: submodules_of_tree
methods.description: Retrieves all submodules within a given tree, excluding nested submodules.

methods.name: submodule_entry_list_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a list of submodule entries.
